items.problem: `test evidence`. The only test that asserts a saved text scale reaches `LocalizationCore` does not fail when `apply_saved_settings` stops applying it. The test calls `set_text_scale(1500)`, then `AccessibilityCore.release()` (line 44) and `init`, and does not release `LocalizationCore`. `AccessibilityCore.release` does not touch `LocalizationCore`, so `get_text_scale` is still 1500 at line 50 with `_apply_text_scale()` removed from `client/godot/core/accessibility_core/accessibility_core.gd:154`. No other test covers this path: `test_saved_values_out_of_their_allowed_values_are_the_default_without_a_log` expects 1000, which is also the value without the call, and the tests of `bootstrap_core` do not read the text scale. So a text scale saved on the device could stop being applied at boot with every test passing. Run path from reading the code; see `## unknown` for the mutation run.

`spec`. DEV says that after `set_test_text_scale`, "On `release` it returns to the saved value", and no test checks it. `### release` (line 83) says the value passed to `LocalizationCore` is reverted by the `release` of that module, and `LocalizationCore.release` sets 1000 (`open-game-works-core/skills/client-core/modules/localization-core.md:119`), not the saved value. Run path: `set_text_scale(1250)`, `AccessibilityCoreDev.set_test_text_scale(1500)`, `AccessibilityCore.release()` leaves `get_text_scale` at 1500; with `LocalizationCore.release()` as well it is 1000 after a new `LocalizationCore.init`. It is 1250 only after the next `AccessibilityCore.init` and `apply_saved_settings` (`client/godot/core/accessibility_core/accessibility_core.gd:117`, `client/godot/core/accessibility_core/accessibility_core.gd:154`). The two sentences of the spec give different values for the time right after `release`.
